{
  "name": "buddy",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "A tiny ASCII pet that lives above your prompt, reacts to everything Claude does, and levels up as you ship.",
  "author": {
    "name": "awesome-claude-mods",
    "url": "https://github.com/Singh-AP/awesome-claude-mods"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/Singh-AP/awesome-claude-mods/tree/main/mods/fun/buddy",
  "repository": "https://github.com/Singh-AP/awesome-claude-mods",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "mod",
    "fun",
    "pet",
    "tamagotchi",
    "gamification",
    "ascii"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "name": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pet name",
      "description": "What your pet is called. /buddy name <name> changes it too.",
      "default": "Byte"
    },
    "species": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Species",
      "description": "Which pet you get. /buddy species <kind> changes it too.",
      "default": "cat",
      "options": [
        "cat",
        "dog",
        "blob",
        "robot",
        "ghost",
        "duck"
      ]
    },
    "sleepAfterSeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Naps after (seconds)",
      "description": "How long without activity before your pet dozes off.",
      "default": 120,
      "min": 10,
      "max": 3600
    }
  }
}
